 <diagram id="system-architecture" name="01 System architecture">

 <mxCell id="title" value="A local app with clear boundaries" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=30;fontColor=#172B4D;fontStyle=1;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">

 </mxCell>

 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="1110" y="28" width="280" height="32"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="local" value="LOCAL MACBOOK / SINGLE USER" style="swimlane;startSize=34;horizontal=1;rounded=1;arcSize=8;container=1;collapsible=0;pointerEvents=0;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#F8FAFD;swimlaneFillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#D7E0EC;strokeWidth=1.5;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#52657D;align=left;spacingLeft=16;" vertex="1" parent="1">

 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="app" value="PYTHON + STREAMLIT PROCESS" style="swimlane;startSize=34;horizontal=1;rounded=1;arcSize=8;container=1;collapsible=0;pointerEvents=0;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#EDF4FF;swimlaneFillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#D7E0EC;strokeWidth=1.5;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#52657D;align=left;spacingLeft=16;" vertex="1" parent="local">

 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="ui" value="<b>Streamlit interface</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Catalog · comparison · conversation<br>Loopback: 127.0.0.1</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="app">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="30" y="50" width="260" height="80"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="controller" value="<b>Request controller</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Pydantic input validation<br>Run ID · request version · cancel</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="app">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="430" y="50" width="290" height="80"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="session" value="<b>Session state</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Budget · exclusions · raw chat<br>In memory; clear on reset</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF5DF;strokeColor=#C89A40;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="app">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="840" y="50" width="260" height="80"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="graph" value="<b>LangGraph workflow</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">One orchestrator · PRD 07<br>Allowlisted Python tools</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=process;size=0.04;" vertex="1" parent="app">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="840" y="190" width="260" height="80"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="services" value="<b>Shared application services</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Catalog &amp; research / Review analysis / Ingredient checks / Ranking / Grounded explanations<br><b>Python owns eligibility, arithmetic, evidence checks and final output.</b></font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="app">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="30" y="310" width="1070" height="90"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="source" value="<b>Source adapter</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Approved HTTPX access<br>Source + variant validation</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EAF7F2;strokeColor=#4C967D;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=process;size=0.04;" vertex="1" parent="app">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="30" y="450" width="260" height="75"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="repositories" value="<b>SQLite repositories</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Transactions + versions<br>Allowlisted persistence</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=process;size=0.04;" vertex="1" parent="app">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="430" y="450" width="290" height="75"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="model" value="<b>Model adapter</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Schemas · timeouts · call caps<br>Cache + usage capture</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F2EDFC;strokeColor=#9270BE;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=process;size=0.04;" vertex="1" parent="app">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="840" y="450" width="260" height="75"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="db" value="<b>SQLite</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Catalog · artifacts · audit events<br>Three opted-in preferences</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EAF7F2;strokeColor=#4C967D;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=cylinder3;size=14;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;" vertex="1" parent="local">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="450" y="665" width="290" height="105"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="ollama" value="<b>Ollama runtime</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Separate local process<br>Model selected by benchmark</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F2EDFC;strokeColor=#9270BE;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=process;size=0.04;" vertex="1" parent="local">

 </mxCell>

 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="local-note" value="<b>Persisted data and reviewed preference saves → page 03</b><br>Ollama and SQLite remain on this device; neither is a hosted dependency." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;fontColor=#172B4D;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="local">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="670" width="350" height="90"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="controls" value="<b>Controls apply across every run</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Typed boundaries · source allowlists · shared deadlines and call budgets · redacted events · stale-result suppression</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F3F6FA;strokeColor=#A4B3C5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="965" width="1360" height="65"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="extension" value="OPTIONAL EXTENSION / Hosted inference is off by default; explicit task policy, sanitized payloads and budget preflight are required." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#172B4D;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="1045" width="1360" height="24"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="source-note" value="TR-01–05, 09–11, 17–23, 28 / PRDs 01–09 / Target design; the runnable app is currently a development preview." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=12;fontColor=#52657D;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="1080" width="1360" height="22"/>
 </mxCell>
 </root>
 </mxGraphModel>
 </diagram>
